s: Dine hambattel reshuto veabar vehotzi ubo z' seipim: hambattel reshuto veabar vehotzi achar kak mibbeto lechatzer, beshogeg — eno oser, bemezid — oser, shehare chozer bo mibbittulo shebbittel lahem chelqo shebbechatzer. Veen omerim kan "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", shekkevan shechozer bo, im ken bevadday lo hissiach libbo legamre mittechilla, velo huttera shabbat meolam. Veenah niqret chazara ella keshemmotzi mibbeto lechatzer. Abal im maknis mechatzer lebeto — en zo chazara, shekkevan shebbittel lahem hechatzer, mepanneh hu et chapatzayv mimmenna labbayit, veeno oser alehem behaknasa zo (abal mikkol maqom asur lo lehaknis mechatzer labbayit, shehare beto meyuchad lo vehechatzer lahem, venimtza motzi mereshut lirshut). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello bittel lahem ella reshuto shebbechatzer bilbad. Abal im bittel lahem gam reshut beto vehiknis mechatzer labbayit — hare zo chazara mibbittul habbayit, veosero alehem. Vekol zeh keshemmotzi o maknis qodem shehecheziqu hem birshut shebbittel, kegon qodem shehotziu mibbattehem lechatzer o hiknisu mechatzer lebattehem keshebbittel lahem reshuto shebbechatzer, o qodem shehotziu mibbeto lechatzer o mechatzer lebeto keshebbittel lahem gam reshut beto. Abal leachar shehecheziqu birshuto, ben behotzaa lebaddah ben behaknasa lebaddah — shub eno yakol lachazor bo. Veap al pi shehaknasa enah niqret chazaqa leinyan chazara, sheen zeh chozer umachaziq birshuto keshemmaknis mimmennu chapatzayv lebeto, ap al pi ken niqret chazaqa leinyan shello yukal lachazor bo, shekkol sheasu dabar birshuto shehayu asurim laasoto im lo bittelah lahem — hare zo chazaqa, veeno oser alehem keshechozer bo. Abal hu asur lehaknis ulehotzi bechatzer ap leachar shehecheziqu bah, ella im ken bittel lahem gam reshut beto, sheaz naaseh keoreach gamur etzlam, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"p. Veen chazaqa moelet ella keshehecheziqu mishshechasheka. Abal mah shemmotziim umaknisim mibbeod yom — en zo hokacha shehi reshut shellahem, shehare ap im lo bittelah lahem hayu rashshaim lehotzi ulehaknis mibbeod yom. Veyesh omerim sheap chazaqa shemmibbeod yom moelet, ap al pi sheenah mokachat, ubilbad shettehe achar habbittul (veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona lekattechilla, ubediabad yesh lehaqel bedibre soperim):

Yesh bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer apillu enan oserot zo al zo, kegon b' chatzerot upetach benehen, veereba kol achat leatzmah velo erebu yachad — yekola kol achat lebattel reshutah lachabertah, shettehe chabertah mutteret lehishtammesh bah velo hi. Veen tzarik lomar im oserot zo al zo, kegon b' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo veereba hachitzona lebaddah vehappenimit lo ereba kelal, sheoseret hi al hachitzona, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"ch — yekola hi lebattel lah reshut sheyyesh lah bah lehishtammesh velidros bah, shello tishtammesh velo taabor aleha ella beshaa shetztzerika latzet velabo, vetihyeh hachitzona mutteret lehishtammesh bachatzerah, ap al pi shehappenimim oberim aleha keshetztzerikim latzet velabo, (ve)haabara lebaddah enah oseret ella keshemmishtammeshim sham laasot tzorkehem. Shezzeh sheameru shehappenimit oseret bidrisat raglah al chitzona — en hakkavvana shedderisat vehaabarat haregel bilbaddah teesor, ella derisat haregel kesheddoreset sham umishtammeshet bitzrakeha bederek tashmish hechatzer lebattim hi oseret otah, kemo sheoserim otah habbattim shebbah im lo erebu bah. Velaken keshebbittela lah zekut zeh veenah mishtammeshet bah beshabbat — enah oseret otah, ap al pi sheoberet aleha. Veken im erebu happenimit vehachitzona beyachad, veshakach echad mehappenimit velo ereb, sheshtehen asurot, kemo shennitbaer sham — yakol hu lebattel lahem reshuto, vetzarik sheyyebattel lekol echad mehappenimit ulekol echad mehachitzona, veaz hu lebaddo asur vekullam muttarim. Abal im lo bittel ella lehappenimit — ap happenimit asura, shehachitzona osartah. Veap al pi sheen lehachitzona derisat haregel aleha, mikkol maqom haerub sheereba imma margilah letokah ukeillu hi dara bah, sheerub mishshum dira. Abal im shakach echad min hachitzona velo ereb — en tzarik lebattel lehappenimit, sheap im lo ereba hachitzona kelal ella happenimit lebaddah, en hachitzona oseret et happenimit, hoil veen lah derisat haregel aleha, veen haerub margilah letokah, mippene sheyyekola lomar lah "letiqqune shittaptika immi velo leivvute". Mah sheen ken kesheshshakach echad min happenimit velo ereb, enah yekola lomar ken kevan shehaivvut hu mimmenna:

Yesh bittul reshut bechurba. Sheim hayu b' battim vechurba benehem shehi shel shenehem (o sheenah shel shenehem abal shenehem mishtammeshim bah betashmish noach, shehem oserim zeh al zeh kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"v), veshakechu velo erebu — yakol echad lebattel lachabero lihyoto muttar bah. Veen omerim shello heqellu chakamim bebittul reshut ella bechatzer shellipne habbattim shebbah hu iqqar tashmisham:

Yesh bittul reshut mibbayit lebayit. Sheim hayu b' battim petuchim zeh lezeh velo erebu yachad — echad mebattel reshut beto lachabero. Vaapillu hambattel muttar lehotzi mibbeto lebet chabero, shehare hakkol shel chabero, kevan shebbittelo lo. Vaapillu qodem shehecheziq chabero bebeto yakol hu lehotzi mimmennu lebet chabero. Veeno domeh lehambattel reshut chatzero, sheen lo lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer, apillu bittel gam reshut beto, ad sheyyachaziqu hem techilla, vaapillu im hecheziqu eno moil ella beyachid shebbittel lerabbim, abal lo beyachid leyachid, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"p — lepi shekkevan shehaya lo cheleq bechatzer ella shebbittelo lahem, im ken keshemmotzi mibbeto lechatzer nireh kechozer mibbittulo umachaziq bechelqo shebbechatzer, velaken tzarik sheyyachaziqu hem techilla, veaz naaseh hu keoreach etzlam im hem rabbim, abal lo yachid etzel yachid. Mah sheen ken keshemmotzi lebet chabero shello haya lo bo cheleq meolam velo bittelo — eno nireh kechozer umachaziq birshuto behotzaa zo:

Abal eno yakol lehaknis mibbet chabero lebeto, shekkeshemmaknis lebeto nireh kechozer umachaziq birshuto. Vaapillu hecheziq bo kebar chabero — eno moil lehattir gam lo, kevan sheeno naaseh keoreach etzel chabero, mippene shehu yachid etzel yachid. Veim hu yachid etzel rabbim — al kol panim lo yaknis lebeto mibbattehem ad sheyyachaziqu hem techilla bebeto. Veim yesh lo cheder patuach lebeto, ubittel reshut beto bilbad beli hacheder — asur lehotzi mehacheder lebeto, shehacheder meyuchad lo, vehabbayit — lachabero, venimtza motzi mereshut lirshut. Vaapillu hu yachid etzel rabbim — eno naaseh keoreach etzlam leinyan hotzaa vehaknasa mecheder lebayit, kemo shehambattel reshut chatzero velo reshut beto eno naaseh keoreach etzlam leinyan hotzaa vehaknasa mibbeto lechatzer, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"p. Abal yakol lehaknis mibbattehem lebeto apillu qodem shehecheziqu hem bebeto, kemo shehambattel reshut chatzero yakol lehotzi mibbattehem lechatzer qodem sheyyachaziqu hem, sheenah niqret chazara ella keshemmotzi mibbeto, abal lo mibbattehem. Veyesh omerim sheen lebattel reshut mibbayit lebayit ella im ken yashir leatzmo cheder echad shello yebattelennu, lepi sheyyesh lachush shello tishtakkach torat erub mibbattim ellu happetuchim zeh lezeh, shekkullam yebattelum baalehem leechad, vegam hem yihyu muttarim lehotzi kol echad mibbeto lebet chabero, hoil veeno nireh kechozer umachaziq birshuto behotzaa zo. Mah sheen ken keshemmashir cheder echad sheasur lehotzi mimmennu labbayit, veim haya erub haya muttar — nimtza mistakker hu baerub, veshub en lachush sheyyebattelu hakkol vetishtakkach torat erub. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona, shehare ap im eno mashir shum cheder — mistakker hu baerub, sheyyehe muttar lo lehaknis lebeto mibbet chabero shebbittel lo beto, sheasur lo akshav apillu leachar shehecheziq bo chabero im hu yachid etzel yachid, veen tzarik lomar rabbim etzel yachid. Veap al pi ken tob lehachamir lekattechilla lehashir cheder echad: h. Habbittul hu bimqom erub shemmibbeod yom. Lepikak bemaqom shello hayu yekolim leareb mibbeod yom, enam yekolim lebattel mishshettechshak. Kegon b' battim bb' tzidde reshut harabbim vehiqqipum nokrim mechitztza beshabbat, beinyan sheyyesh benehen kemo chatzer sheb' battim ellu petuchim lah, vahare hem oserim zeh al zeh — enam yekolim lebattel echad lachabero, kevan shello hayu yekolim leareb mibbeod yom:

Abal mi sheyyarash bayit beshabbat veniknas ladur bo, sheoser hu al bene hechatzer, kegon shello ereb immahem hammorish — yakol lebattel lahem reshuto. Veap al pi shello haya yakol leareb immahem mibbeod yom, shehare lo haya dar bebayit zeh mibbeod yom, mikkol maqom, hayyoresh — bimqom morisho hu omed, vahare morisho haya yakol leareb, laken yakol hu lebattel:

Mebattelin vechozerin umebattelin. Kelomar shemmebattelin reshutan bene chatzer zo libne chatzer acheret sheereba leatzman, o leechad mibbene chatzer, ad sheyyotziu mah sheyyirtzu, vechozerim umebattelim reshutam leotam shebbittelu lahem ad sheyyotziu gam hem mah sheyyirtzu. Abal im lo hayu chozerim umebattelim lahem — lo hayu muttarim lehotzi apillu bittelu gam reshut battehem, hoil vehem rabbim veenam naasim orechim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"p:
